The correct answer is Assam.

Key Points

  •  The Bihu dance is an indigenous folk dance from the Indian state of Assam related to the Bihu festival and an important part of Assamese culture.
  • The Bihu dance takes its name from the Bohag Bihu festival also called Rangali Bihu,the national festival of Assam, which celebrates the Assamese New Year.
  • The festival takes place during mid-April and the Bihu dance is meant to celebrate and emulate the seasonal spirit, celebrating fertility and passion.
  •  Assam without talking about the world famous Bihu dance, which has become the identity of the northeastern state.
    • Performed mostly during the annual Bihu festival celebrated around April, it is Assam's most popular folk dance.

​Additional Information

  • Jhumar is a traditional folk dance of Bihar, which is performed by the rural women.
    • There is no fixed season for this beautiful dance form, it is a dance, which is performed at all times. 
    • Jat-Jatin is the most popular folk dance of North Bihar, especially in the Mithila and Koshi regions. It is performed by a man and a woman the man is going far away to work.
  • The Chalo dance is part of Arunachal Pradesh's called Chalo Loku. This festival is a grand celebration in the state and takes place every year in October and November.

questions.question: Which among the following dance forms of India is associated with Rajasthan?
questions.questionHtml: Which among the following dance forms of India is associated with Rajasthan?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Kalbelia.

Key Points

  • Kalbelia
    • Kalbelia or kalbeliya dance form is associated with a Rajasthani tribe of the same name.
    • Kalbeliya dance was included in UNESCO’s list of the Cultural Heritage of Humanity in 2010.
    • It is performed by the women of the Kalbeliya community.
    • Kalbeliya dancer's clothes are flowing black skirts mixed in red and black hues and embroidered in unique patterns.
    • Kalbeliya dance has traditional musical instruments known as Poongi.

Additional Information

Dance Form Description
Odissi Originated from the Eastern Indian state of Odisha, Odissi is one of the oldest classical dance forms in India. It is characterized by its graceful and expressional performance. The dance is a blend of Nritta (pure dance), Nritya (dance with emotions) and Natya (dramatic representation). Odissi is typically accompanied by musicians, where the dancer's motions express the song's narrative and emotions.
Bharatanatyam Bharatanatyam is a classical Indian dance form originating from Tamil Nadu. This dance form is known for its grace, elegance, purity, tenderness, expression and sculpturesque poses. Bharatanatyam generally follows the theoretical framework outlined in the Natya Shastra, an ancient text for theater and performance arts. The dance is highly symbolic and includes gestures (mudras) that communicate stories from Indian mythology and spiritual ideas.
Kathakali Kathakali is a major form of classical Indian dance originating in the Indian state of Kerala. It is a performance art that combines dancing, acting, vocal music, percussion, costumes and make-up. Kathakali's stories are taken from the Indian epics and Puranas, and the performance is characterized by its dramatic and elaborate costumes and makeup, as well as the detailed gestures, expressions and dance movements.

questions.solution:
The correcct asnwer is Lavani.

Key Points

  • Lavani is a famous folk-dance form of Maharashtra State.
    • Lavani is a combination of traditional song and dance, which particularly performed to the beats of Dholki, a percussion instrument.
    • Lavani is noted for its powerful rhythm.
    • Lavani has contributed substantially to the development of Marathi folk theatre.
    • In Maharashtra and southern Madhya Pradesh, it is performed by the female performers wearing nine-yard long sarees.
    • The songs are sung in a quick tempo.
    • Lavani dance originated from Maharashtra in the 18th and 19th centuries.
    • Lavani dancers were patronized by Maratha Lords and Kings.
    • Lavani dance was generally performed by Dhangars or Shepherd living in the Solapur, Maharashtra
    • Traditionally, this genre of folk dance deals with different and varied subject matters such as society, religion, and politics.
    • The songs in 'Lavani' are mostly erotic in sentiment and the dialogues tend to be pungent in socio-political satire.
    • Originally, it was used as a form of entertainment and morale booster to the tired soldiers.

Additional Information

  • Bharatanatyam is a classical dance form that originated in the state of Tamil Nadu, India.

  • Bharatanatyam is traditionally performed by women and has its origins in the temples of Tamil Nadu.
  • The dance form has a rich history and is often accompanied by classical Carnatic music.
  • It embodies the elements of music, rhythm, and expressional dance, and it expresses South Indian religious themes and spiritual ideas.

Additional Information

  • Bharatanatyam has a long and rich history dating back to ancient Tamil Nadu, and it is mentioned in the Tamil epic Silappatikaram and other ancient texts.
  • The dance form was revitalized in the 20th century by pioneers such as Rukmini Devi Arundale, who helped to bring it to the global stage.
  • Bharatanatyam is characterized by its grace, purity, tenderness, and sculpturesque poses.
  • The dance is usually performed by a solo dancer and includes a repertoire of items such as Alarippu, Jatiswaram, Shabdam, Varnam, Padams, and Tillana.

Key Points

  • Sattriya is one of the eight classical dance forms of India.
  • This dance form originated in the state of Assam.
  • Sattriya dance was introduced by the Vaishnav saint and reformer Sankaradeva in the 15th century.
  • The dance form is a representation of the mythological narratives and teachings of Vaishnavism.
  • It was traditionally performed in Sattras (monasteries) as a part of religious rituals and to convey spiritual messages.
  • Sattriya has been recognized as a classical dance by the Sangeet Natak Akademi in 2000.

Additional Information

  • The dance form is characterized by expressive hand gestures, rhythmic footwork, and intricate body movements.
  • The traditional attire for Sattriya dance includes a costume made of silk, adorned with traditional Assamese jewelry.
  • The musical accompaniment for Sattriya includes instruments like the khol (a type of drum), taals (cymbals), and flute.
  • Today, Sattriya dance has moved beyond the Sattras and is performed on various cultural platforms across India and the world.

questions.solution: Mohiniyattam is a classical dance form from Kerala, India, known for its graceful and feminine movements, often performed solo by women. Combining elements of Bharatanatyam and Kathakali, Mohiniyattam derives its name from "Mohini," a female avatar of Vishnu, and "attam," meaning dance. It is one of the eight classical dances recognized by the Sangeet Natak Akademi.

questions.question: Pandit Birju Maharaj choreographed the song 'Kahe Chhed Mohe' from the movie Devdas. He was mainly associated with which dance form?

questions.solution: Pandit Birju Maharaj is a renowned Indian classical dancer and choreographer who is mainly associated with the Kathak dance form. He belongs to the Lucknow gharana of Kathak and has received several awards and recognition for his contribution to the art form. The song "Kahe Chhed Mohe" from the movie Devdas is a classic example of Pandit Birju Maharaj's Kathak choreography.

questions.question: Who among the following dancers is associated with Indian classical dance form of Kathak?
questions.questionHtml: Who among the following dancers is associated with Indian classical dance form of Kathak?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Pandit Birju Maharaj

Key Points

  • Pandit Birju Maharaj is a renowned Indian classical dancer associated with the Kathak dance form.
  • He is recognized as one of the leading exponents of Kathak and has been instrumental in popularizing this dance form globally.
  • Birju Maharaj has received numerous awards and accolades, including the Padma Vibhushan, India's second-highest civilian award.
  • He comes from a family of Kathak dancers, with his father and uncles also being prominent figures in the world of Kathak.
  • Amubi Singh is associated with Manipuri dance.
  • Dr. Kanak Rele is known for her expertise in Mohiniyattam.
  • Dr. Minati Mishra is associated with Odissi dance.

Additional Information

  • Kathak is one of the eight major forms of Indian classical dance.
  • It traces its origins to the nomadic bards of ancient northern India, known as Kathakars or storytellers.
  • The dance form is characterized by intricate footwork, spins, and expressive gestures and facial expressions.
  • Kathak has evolved over the centuries, incorporating elements from both Hindu and Muslim cultures.
  • It is traditionally performed to the accompaniment of classical Indian music, including instruments like the tabla and harmonium.

questions.question: Ghoomar dance is associated with which of the following states?
questions.questionHtml: Ghoomar dance is associated with which of the following states?
questions.solution: Ghoomar is a traditional folk dance from the state of Rajasthan. The name is derived from "ghoomna," meaning spinning or twirling. It is performed to traditional Rajasthani folk music, featuring instruments like the Dhol, Nagada, Shehnai, and Harmonium. Ghoomar is commonly performed at weddings, and festivals such as Teej, Gangaur, and Diwali, symbolizing joy, communal harmony, and social unity with participation from women of all ages. Other states have their own dances, such as Lavani and Powada in Maharashtra, Bhangra and Giddha in Punjab, and Jawara and Matki in Madhya Pradesh.

questions.question: Which of the following is a classical dance form from Andhra Pradesh?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following is a classical dance form from Andhra Pradesh?
questions.solution: Kuchipudi is a classical dance form that originated in Andhra Pradesh and takes its name from the village of Kuchipudi. It is known for its dynamic footwork, fast-paced movements, and the blend of dance, music, and acting.
